identity.description: Mermaid CLI (mmdc), the command-line tool from the mermaid-js project that renders Mermaid diagram files to SVG/PNG/PDF. Installed as npm package @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli. It is a local tool, not a hosted SaaS API.
identity.identity_notes: The mermaid-js/mermaid-cli GitHub README describes it as a CLI for mermaid and gives npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli. Note: Mermaid Chart (mermaid.ai / mermaidchart.com) is a separate commercial product that also has a hosted Mermaid MCP server; it is not the same as mermaid-cli.

auth.scopes_notes: No authentication or credentials are mentioned for mermaid-cli in its README. The only 'auth' hits were in the Mermaid Chart hosted MCP server (OAuth login or a manual token), which is a different product.

api.limitations: Core function is one-way conversion of a Mermaid definition file to SVG/PNG/PDF. The README warns the Node.js API is not covered by semver. No webhooks or hosted endpoints were found.

claims.value: Mermaid CLI is a command-line interface for mermaid that takes a mermaid definition file and generates SVG/PNG/PDF.
